info.headline: Severe Weather Warning for North West Pastoral, North East Pastoral, West Coast, Eastern Eyre Peninsula, Flinders, Mid North and Yorke Peninsula forecast districts
info.description:
DAMAGING WINDS averaging 55 to 65 km/h with peak gusts of around 90 km/h are possible about coastal parts of western Eyre Peninsula. DAMAGING WIND GUSTS of around 90 km/h are also possible for the northern Yorke Peninsula and further inland in the North West Pastoral. Conditions are forecast to ease below warning thresholds by late Sunday evening.
DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 75 km/h with peak gusts of around 110 km/h are likely about the higher parts of the Flinders Ranges from late Sunday afternoon, easing below warning thresholds by around sunrise on Monday morning. Locations which may be affected include Ceduna, Hawker, Jamestown, Woomera, Kadina, Burra, Arkaroola, Peterborough and Streaky Bay.
Severe weather is no longer occurring in the Lower Eyre Peninsula district and the warning for this district is CANCELLED.
info.instruction: The State Emergency Service advises that people should: * Move vehicles under cover or away from trees; * Secure or put away loose items around your property. * Stay indoors, away from windows, while conditions are severe.
